//: ts-node project for the #222 CI acceptance probe. The probe imports the shared PaidRoundTripClient from test/integration and the connector src, which the main tsconfig (rootDir ./src, src-only include) excludes. This config widens rootDir to the repo so ts-node can resolve src + test + the scripts/ entrypoint, while inheriting strict settings from the base. transpileOnly is set on the ts-node side via the npm flag, so this only needs to satisfy module resolution.
